item_short_desc: Rothco’s Tactical Duty Belt is constructed of heavy-duty material to ensure stability and reliability while holding the weight of your professional gear. The police belt is also fully adjustable comfortable fitting most waist sizes.
description: Rothco’s Tactical Duty Belt is constructed of a heavy-duty material to ensure stability and reliability while holding the weight of your professional gear. The police belt is also fully adjustable comfortable fitting most waist sizes.  Hold public safety items such as your firearm, handcuffs, and other uniform gear. The belt is equipped with two removable pouches with hook & loop closures that are ideal for storing folding knives or other small security items.  The 2" wide quick release buckle allows for easy removal. Tactical belt fits a 48" waist at the largest and 29.5" at the smallest.  Tactical belt is ideally worn by police, military, public safety, and law enforcement personnel.
